question: Can one local full effective RHS linearization remain consistent at tolerance-scale displacements in the same real 125 us block, without spatial row selection?
choice_after_A: Direct per-callback source and row MRI realizations exceeded six equivalent base passes at their observed 229 fast calls. This B screen is a distinct full-operator JVP feasibility test, not an MRI retune or speed claim.
direction: Use slow_f[1] from archived five-stage MRI; set prescribed entries to zero and scale once so max |v_i|/(1e-7+1e-5|z_i|)=1. No amplitude retry.
limitations: A finite-difference screen does not implement Arnoldi or show that Krylov uses fewer products over a block.
